## Analysis by Month
``` {r analysisByMonth, eval = T, warning = F, echo = F}
# SQL Query to get the number of monthly incidents
monthly_incidents <- dbGetQuery(
conn,
"SELECT
    MONTH(date) AS month_num,
    MONTHNAME(date) AS month_name,
    incident_type,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count
  FROM Incidents
  GROUP BY month_num, month_name, incident_type
  ORDER BY month_num, incident_type
"
)

# Creating the dataframe
months <- c(
"January",
"February",
"March",
"April",
"May",
"June",
"July",
"August",
"September",
"October",
"November",
"December"
)

incident_types <- unique(monthly_incidents$incident_type)

incidents_df <- data.frame(Month = months)
for (t in incident_types) {
# Initialize each value to 0
incidents_df[[t]] <- 0
}

# For each row in the monthly incidents table
for (i in 1:nrow(monthly_incidents)) {
month <- monthly_incidents$month_name[i]
type <- monthly_incidents$incident_type[i]
count <- monthly_incidents$incident_count[i]

idx <- match(month, incidents_df$Month)
incidents_df[idx, type] <- count
}


incidents_df %>%
kable("latex", align = "c") %>%
kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
position = "center", latex_options = "HOLD_position")

```


## Analysis by Airline
``` {r analysisByAirline, eval = T, warning = F, echo = F}

# SQL to create a view called airline_summary containing the avg delay (rounded to 
# 2 decimals), and the total number of incidents
# Surround with invisible to suppress presence in knitted pdf
invisible(dbExecute(conn, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW airline_summary AS
  SELECT 
    f.airline,
    COUNT(*) AS total_incidents,
    ROUND(AVG(i.delay_mins), 2) AS avg_delay_minutes
  FROM Incidents i
  JOIN Flights f ON i.flight_number = f.flight_number
  GROUP BY f.airline
"))

# Get the airline summary
airline_summary <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT * FROM airline_summary")

# Present the airline summer in a table through kable
airline_summary %>%
  kable("latex", caption = "Incident Summary by Airline",
        col.names = c("Airline", "Total Incidents", "Avg. Delay (min)"),
        align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                position = "center", latex_options = "HOLD_position")


```


## Trend by Year
``` {r trendByYear, eval = T, warning = F, echo = F}

# Create a view that contains the year to easily extract in the 2nd step
# Surround it with 'invisible' to suppress output for the knitted pdf
invisible(dbExecute(conn, "DROP VIEW IF EXISTS IncidentYears"))

# Select the year substring of date, which will be indices 1-4, since the
# format of the dates is YYYY-MM-DD
invisible(dbExecute(conn, "CREATE VIEW IncidentYears AS
SELECT *, SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) AS year
FROM 
  Incidents;
"))

# Extract the year 
yearly_counts <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS num_incidents
FROM 
  IncidentYears
GROUP BY 
  year
ORDER BY 
  year;")

# Convert the yearly_counts year to be a number, so that we can sort it for
# the line chart
yearly_counts$year <- as.numeric(yearly_counts$year)
yearly_counts <- yearly_counts[order(yearly_counts$year), ]

# Use the plot function in r to plot the data
plot(
  x = yearly_counts$year,
  y = yearly_counts$num_incidents,
  type = "o",
  col = "black",
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Number of Incidents",
  main = "Yearly Incident Counts"
)


```
